Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your data regarding the cost model, the delivery scorecard, and the increased demand forecast. While our pricing flexibility is highly restricted at this time, we are committed to finding a mutually beneficial agreement through adjusted commercial terms. Building on your third package, we can agree to 60 days payment and a 24-month contract at a unit price of EUR 430.68. Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. We can alternatively offer a price of €430.68 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Thank you for your revised proposal. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

As previously advised, our management has strictly frozen price reductions, meaning we cannot accommodate a lower price for the requested terms and must hold firm at EUR 432.15. Therefore, our offer remains a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION. Should you be able to increase the annual volume, we would be prepared to re-evaluate the commercial terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
